title: Mishlove's remote viewing trial at SRI
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Mishlove's remote viewing trial at SRI, about February 1976 at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So in February 1976, they had invited me to SRRI to experience remote viewing, which I did and and had a very successful trial at the time.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher and interviewer, says that in February 1976 he was invited to SRI, the Stanford Research Institute, a research lab in California, by the researchers Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ to try remote viewing. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a faraway place or object using only the mind. Mishlove says his trial there was very successful.
